candidates.name: google/gemma-4-E2B-it-assistant (official MTP drafter, ~78M)
candidates.provenance: Official Google MTP drafter for gemma-4-E2B-it; custom gemma4_assistant GGUF architecture
candidates.physical_update: User-authorized isolated experiment executed on b9553 (the last working loader build) with the official assistant converted to Q8_0 GGUF via the b10182 converter. With product-matching server flags (-ctk/-ctv q8_0 --jinja --reasoning off --reasoning-budget 0, --spec-type draft-mtp): draft acceptance 28.3% (1558/5508), free chat p50 regressed 2.546->3.383s (+33%), the real P payload gained nothing (2.468 vs 2.498s), visible chat outputs changed in 3/4 cases, VRAM +108 MiB. Rejected on the exact-output, latency and resource gates simultaneously; see b9553_mtp_assistant_verdict_20260730.json. Prior status kept for history:
evidence: llama.cpp PR #24282 (merged 2026-06-08) adds E2B/E4B assistant conversion/loading on top of Gemma4 MTP PR #23398 (2026-06-07)

Open regression ggml-org/llama.cpp#24795 (opened 2026-06-19, still open, no fix PR): gemma4-assistant draft load crashes with 'invalid vector subscript' on b9702/b9717+; last known working build is b9553
BAXY prior probe on b10182 could not create a draft context (llama_b10182_mtp_verdict_20260729.json); registered b9980 is inside the regressed range
Community reports ~2.5x speedup and ~62% draft acceptance on b9553 with deterministic prompts; CUDA FlashAttention hard-abort also reported for some head configurations
candidates.reason: Highest-upside latency candidate (exact-output speculative decoding of the same certified target), but productive support does not exist for any build >= the canonical b9980. Adopting it today would require downgrading llama-server below the certified revision to b9553, whose compatibility with the current E2B GGUF layout is unverified (b8738 already failed to load it), plus a new attested asset. Re-test when ggml-org/llama.cpp#24795 is fixed in a release >= b9980.

candidates.name: Qwen3.5-4B (released 2026-03-02)
candidates.provenance: Alibaba Qwen; hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention, multimodal, 262k context; official GGUFs published (e.g. unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-MTP-GGUF); Qwen docs: convert-hf-to-gguf supported, 'absolute latest' llama.cpp required for the new operators

capability_breakdown.load_and_execution: supported only on llama.cpp builds newer than the certified b9980 vintage; MTP needs custom build (PR #22673)
capability_breakdown.grammar_structured_output: server-side GBNF is architecture-agnostic; unverified physically on hybrid models
capability_breakdown.productive_maturity: not mature for BAXY's workload: hybrid/recurrent models force full prompt re-processing between requests (ggml-org/llama.cpp#21831 open; #22746 same class for Qwen3.6; #25913 slot save/restore loses reuse; #21681 prompt-cache state drift closed)

candidates.reason: Corrected after reaudit with official sources: the architecture IS runnable on recent llama.cpp, but the open prompt-reuse defects for hybrid DeltaNet models attack exactly BAXY's hot path (every P/G/L/V call reuses a 554-1214-token cached prefix; measured cache_n in turn_retry_decomposition_full_20260730.json). Full re-prefill of ~1.2k tokens per call on this GPU would add roughly 0.9-1s per inference regardless of decode speed, so the expected value is negative until the upstream cache-reuse issues close AND a supported runtime at or above the certified revision exists. Reversal condition: #21831 fixed in an official release, then run the physical funnel.

verdict: No candidate passes phase 1 with a credible, certifiable latency or quality win on the canonical hardware without new attested assets. The single high-upside path (official E2B MTP assistant) is blocked by an open llama.cpp loader regression covering every build at or above the certified b9980. Gemma 4 E2B QAT Q4_K_XL remains the correct asset; re-open this funnel when issue #24795 ships a fix in an official release.
